Every month,
premiums stop.

Usually not because a client decided to stop paying.

What actually happened
A bank order fails.
A card is reissued.
Somebody changes jobs.
Where we notice

The 45-day line.

Past the grace period. Early enough that a phone call still works.

Who crossed it today. How long they have held cover. How they pay. And whose they are.

Click any bar and the whole wall holds to it.

What the client receives

Six versions,
by how long
they have been
with us.

It opens with the years.
Not the arrears.

One tap

Rate the service — then say what else is on your mind.

numbers to tap

Private and confidential

To the branch
manager alone.

Not to their agent. Not to the office. Not written to any branch sheet — only that they wrote, so we can prove we answered.

At sixty days

We write again — and we remember what they told us the first time.

At ninety

We stop asking them to rate us, and start offering ways to keep the cover.
